defect.evidence_quote: While it may be true that under the common law of property the threshold of one's dwelling is "private," as is the yard surrounding the house, it is nonetheless clear that under the cases interpreting the Fourth Amendment Santana was in a "public" place.

defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-42 with the exact p.42 opinion passage, or make the page quote an explicitly edited quotation with accurate ellipses and original quotation marks.

reasons: The disclosed lake/group quote for pin-42 contains page-authored headings such as '## Issue' and '## Rule', not opinion text.
The actual opinion text at the p.42 passage says the threshold is "private" under common law but a "public" place under Fourth Amendment cases; it does not contain the harvested fragment.
The displayed content_page quote also changes the opinion's double quotation marks around "private" and "public" to single quotation marks.
residual_risks: The underlying doorway-as-public-place proposition is supported by the opinion; the defect is quote extraction/fidelity.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Regenerate pin-42 from the cached opinion page *42 and preserve original quotation marks; do not let page headings enter pinpoint quotes.

defect.proposed_fix: Store a normalized plain-text quote or keep opinion/citation formatting out of the quoted characters while recording formatting separately.
